findings.title: Pending preservation omits mechanical callback silence
findings.evidence: _pending_cases never clears/enables _watch or checks _events.is_empty(), whereas refusal cases 255-259 and repeated validation 267-275 do. _record records only while _watch is true.
findings.impact: A fired/world-action/action-resolved/progression/native-cancel callback during pending cancellation, validation reentry or candidate disposal can remain invisible if final packet/native state bytes match. The stated pending donor-preservation scope therefore lacks a signal observation.
findings.required_inert_repair: For each pending case, clear events, watch the actual pending operation through final settling/cleanup, restore watch state, and require strict callback silence with only the existing exact lifecycle retirement classification. Preserve a nonempty full before/during/after guard.

findings.title: Donor guard omits actual installed Camera3D state
findings.evidence: _atomic_signature includes the complete unit.shell focus/shake/input packet and full native Hero/source/Scheduler/floor diagnostics. It does not encode actual Shell.camera transform, identity/world or projection state.
findings.impact: A pending _process update may alter the real installed camera pose while serialized focus/shake/input remains exact. This would escape the current atomic guard and cannot support the explicitly stated donor camera preservation scope.
findings.required_inert_repair: Add a nonempty typed actual installed Camera3D diagnostic to the atomic guard: actual native identity/world, encoded global transform and actual projection fields used by Shell (including projection, size, fov, near/far and keep_aspect). The encoded data remain observation-only and are never saved-packet authority or optical acceptance.

findings.title: Post-entry floor refusal leaves zero-entry raw preparation failure uncovered
findings.evidence: All four floor faults dispatch validate_once with _fault_candidate, which requires level.is_restore_candidate(). The intact registered observer requires matching real rays and zero entries. A truthful workable ordering is healthy raw -> healthy registered -> successful sole constructor -> isolated floor fault -> real synchronous validator refusal. This is a postconstruction validator test, not a raw preparation-error test. Original wording raw/registered and malformed/preparation refusal conflates those paths. Pending cancel/disposal are control interruptions, not independent native preparation errors.
findings.impact: The required preservation on failed native preparation before any restore entry cannot be established by these four post-entry validation cases. Corrupting before the successful registered observer would instead fail the positive readiness assertions for the wrong reason.
findings.required_inert_repair: Keep those four cases explicitly postconstruction. Add a distinct fixture-only bridge preparation-failure case with a healthy raw observation, corruption restricted to a distinct unentered candidate at a concrete Root-mapped custody point, the actual preparation refusal/error, zero restore entries and quiet commits, unchanged full donor/model/disk/native/camera/input guard, strict callback silence, and all original candidate WeakRefs freed. Do not label the deliberately failed candidate registered/entered or call a validator solely to manufacture preparation credit. Do not invent shared/public runtime hooks.
findings.mapping_constraint: FIRST unsealed Root snapshot captures immutable floor custody in _registration_row at 1000 and checks it during preparation at 1133-1136. An eventual mapping must identify its actual hook/custody point; corruption before baseline capture can become the baseline and only fail later. These historical lines establish the distinction, not the current implementation contract.
